groups.I1 GATE_REJECTED with no unspent reply o: rejectSwarmCheckpoint (core/tools/aidlc-swarm-checkpoints.ts) writes one GATE_REJECTED per Unit of the batch from one reply, so each row after the first stands on a reply the first already spent
groups.I2 GATE_REJECTED names no message: rejectSwarmCheckpoint writes the batch reject's GATE_REJECTED rows with the protected response's words (readProtectedResponse) and no Message Id; `bolt swarm-checkpoint --action reject` takes no --message
groups.I2 QUESTION_ANSWERED names no message: handleAnswer (core/tools/aidlc-log.ts) with no --message and no question Message Id to inherit takes Person Reply from latestPersonTurn and writes no Message Id
groups.I2 SUMMARY_CONFIRMATION_RECORDED names n: the summary confirmation in handleAnswer (core/tools/aidlc-log.ts) takes Person Reply from latestPersonTurn and writes no Message Id
groups.I2 VERIFICATION_COMMAND_RECORDED names n: the verification command answer in handleAnswer (core/tools/aidlc-log.ts) takes Person Reply from the protected response (protectedPersonsWords) and writes no Message Id
groups.I2 the gate-words record dropped some of: recordGateWords (core/tools/aidlc-lib.ts) keeps no message over GATE_WORDS_MAX_CHARS (8000) and at most GATE_WORDS_MAX_MESSAGES (8) a chat, and marks the rest dropped
groups.I5 the person's words copied into GATE_R: rejectSwarmCheckpoint with no --reason writes changeRequestWords of the person's words into Reason and Feedback
